hire.step1Body: You send the product and the problem; I assess whether it is something I can help with and reply. If it is not, I will say so.
hire.step2Body: A 30-minute call, then I write the scope document — deliverables, duration, what is included and what is not, and the access I will need.
hire.step3Body: We adjust the scope document together and confirm it.
hire.step4Body: A written progress update once a week. Live questions during the CET-morning window.
hire.step5Body: A review round, fixes, then documentation of what changed and how it was measured.
hire.processNote: From first inquiry to starting work is typically under a week. The delivery timeline is set together during scoping.
hire.title: Work with me
hire.tagline: Frontend and delivery for browser apps that handle 3D visualization and large datasets — remote.
hire.intro: I work on the part that is harder than the layout — rendering large datasets without stalling the browser, keeping multi-megabyte visualization libraries off the critical path, and shipping it all through a release pipeline the team can actually trust. I have built 3D structure viewers, multi-megabyte visualization library integrations, and chart dashboards over large datasets, all in production products.
hire.service1Body: Integrating 3D/WebGL viewers and node-heavy interactive workspaces into an existing app — including isolating multi-megabyte libraries route by route so initial load does not suffer.
hire.service2Body: Finding what actually makes a React app slow, then fixing it structurally: route-scoped loading, code splitting, and render-path profiling — reported with before/after numbers you can reproduce.
hire.service3Body: Standing up or tightening the release path — containerized E2E, full-suite regression runs, dependency and quality scanning, and build/image optimization.
hire.how1Body: Late afternoon in Korea overlaps with the Central European morning, giving a dependable 3-4 hour window for live collaboration each day (17:00 KST is 09:00 CET). I worked across exactly that gap for a year and eight months with a production plant team in Serbia, coordinating process definitions and feedback — and worked remotely for a Korean startup.
hire.how2Body: Including direct coordination with overseas teams on technical requirements and process definitions.
hire.how3Body: I document what changed, why, and how it was measured, so the team can carry the work forward once the engagement ends. On a short contract, that documentation is effectively the entire handover.
hire.ctaBody: Send a brief overview of the product and the technical challenge you're addressing. I'll follow up with an assessment of scope and fit.

about.title: About
about.intro: I build React/Next.js products end to end — from backend API integration through CI/CD, test automation, and security review. Most of my recent work has been on data-intensive platforms in biotech: 3D molecular visualization, scientific charting, and the bundle-size and delivery-pipeline discipline that keeps those products fast to load and safe to ship. I also use Claude Code and Codex to automate parts of testing, review, and refactoring in day-to-day development.
